checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: About 10 s widescreen video with friendly intelligible English voice-over
must.why: The audio is 9 s with sound and peak -1.5 dB. I can't judge the words or tone. The 16:9 format is fine, but the length is about 9 s.

must.item: Water rises as vapor, clouds form, rain falls, in order
must.why: Clip 1 shows faint vapor over the lake. Clip 2 shows a big cloud column building. No rain clip was provided, so I can't confirm the rain.

must.item: Labels read exactly Evaporation, Condensation, Precipitation
must.why: Clip 1 has no 'Evaporation' text in any of its four frames. 'Condensation' is spelled right. 'Precipitation' was not seen.

must.item: Each label legible and with its stage, in order
must.why: 'Condensation' is legible, but it appears only at the start of clip 2 and fades out by 1.2 s. 'Evaporation' is absent. 'Precipitation' was not seen.
No extra text appears in the frames provided.

exact_text.read_as: No text visible in clip 1 frames
Not visible in the provided frames

faults.what: The 'Evaporation' label never appears in clip 1. Each stage was supposed to start from a still with its label drawn in, but the label was lost.
The 'Condensation' label shows only briefly at the start of clip 2 and then disappears. It sits over the cloud.
The cloud is a dense pillar rising straight out of the lake, like a geyser or explosion. It does not look like clouds forming in the sky, and it covers most of the lake.
The scene and palette change abruptly between clip 1 (hazy, yellow, sun-glare) and clip 2 (bright blue sky, different framing). The result is an inconsistent look.
The evaporation vapor is very faint and hard to see.
No rain or 'Precipitation' stage appears in the provided frames. The audio is 9 s, not 10 s.

summary: The clips show a pleasant cartoon lake with faint vapor, then a large cloud column, but the 'Evaporation' label is missing, 'Condensation' fades after about a second, and no rain or 'Precipitation' label was visible.
